unresolved_candidate.description: The client requires Danish as the default, while the freelancer states that the document will default to English with Danish style names. Event extraction should preserve the client requirement and treat any unresolved technical conflict separately.

Some bullet failures may result from using Tab rather than the style ribbon. Evidence does not yet fully resolve whether every reported case is an implementation defect, a user-workflow limitation, or both.

The exact final architecture for ordinary text areas is not fully explicit: plain editable text, modern content controls, and visible duplicated help text are discussed. The behavioral Requirements are separable, but the implementation choice may need audit.

The Master-template report that tables do not work and text is duplicated lacks the attached examples. Routing to table stability versus field-content uniqueness is plausible but should be verified from local evidence.

PowerPoint details such as logo placement, image masks, bullet capacity, backgrounds, and heading spacing are posed as design questions and are not yet sufficiently confirmed to become separate Requirement Atoms.
